items.title: 67460_Sammy Price oral history interview
items.q: we got up to playing with Louis and the Mayers and Baby Dodds, Pops Foster and Jimmy Archey and Henry Goodwin

ctx.x: Jack Teagarden, yeah. Jack was amazing. Jack use to go into a town and...he had a very, very sensitive

ear about tone, you see, and true tone. Jack would go into a town and if there was just one note off on that piano he'd take off his clothes and tune the piano. But we were out at--I think it was LaGuardia... I don't think Kennedy was in existence at that time and...Kennedy wasn't in existence at that time, and all the airports were just being built and they just had one shed. I can never forget the time that, you know, when we got up to playing with Louis and the Mayers and Baby Dodds, Pops Foster and Jimmy…
